settings.question: Is this really AI-generated?
settings.answer: Yes. We use your uploaded couple photos and chosen destination or style direction to generate realistic, editorial wedding imagery.

settings.question: How long does it take?
settings.answer: Most wedding story albums are delivered within 3-5 days depending on your plan, revision needs, and output count.

settings.question: Can I request styles?
settings.answer: Yes. You can choose destination moods, ceremony aesthetics, wardrobe direction, and cinematic or editorial styling during the workflow.

settings.question: Are photos high-resolution?
settings.answer: Yes. Final deliveries are prepared for digital sharing and keepsake printing, with quality depending on your selected package.

settings.question: Can I print the photos?
settings.answer: Yes. Delivered files are intended for keepsakes, announcements, framed prints, and private wedding albums.

settings.title: FAQ
settings.subtitle: Answer pricing, privacy, uploads, and plan questions before customers spend credits.
settings.journeyDescriptions: Add clean source photos.|Pick a scene or style.|AI builds your set.|Download from the private gallery.

settings.question: Can I try DreamShootAI for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Uploads, jobs, albums, orders, and credits are scoped to the current site and the current customer account.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.question: Can I try DreamShootAI for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Uploads, jobs, albums, orders, and credits are scoped to the current site and the current customer account.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@dreamshootai.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Ledger handling

Refunds and billing reversals are recorded against this storefront. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is written through the credit ledger.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@dreamshootai.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the current storefront and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in the ledger.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@dreamshootai.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.title: Frequently asked questions
settings.subtitle: Answer the objections customers have before uploading private photos.

settings.question: What photos should customers upload?
settings.answer: Clear, recent selfies with varied angles and expressions work best. Couple models should include individual photos for each person.

settings.question: Does the AI worker decide billing?
settings.answer: No. The product backend reserves, consumes, and releases credits. N8N only performs generation work.

settings.question: Can draft edits break the live storefront?
settings.answer: No. The live site reads published_json. Draft changes stay in the designer until Publish snapshot is pressed.

settings.question: Can this page be rearranged like a store homepage?
settings.answer: Yes. Sections and child blocks can be added, removed, reordered, edited, saved as draft, and published.

settings.title: FAQ
settings.subtitle: Answer pricing, privacy, uploads, and plan questions before customers spend credits.
settings.journeyDescriptions: Add clean source photos.|Pick a scene or style.|AI builds your set.|Download from the private gallery.

settings.question: Can I try DreamShootAI for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Uploads, jobs, albums, orders, and credits are scoped to the current site and the current customer account.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.question: Can I try DreamShootAI for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Uploads, jobs, albums, orders, and credits are scoped to the current site and the current customer account.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@dreamshootai.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Ledger handling

Refunds and billing reversals are recorded against this storefront. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is written through the credit ledger.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the current storefront and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in the ledger.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@dreamshootai.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.question: Can I try DreamShootAI for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Uploads, jobs, albums, orders, and credits are scoped to the current site and the current customer account.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@dreamshootai.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Ledger handling

Refunds and billing reversals are recorded against this storefront. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is written through the credit ledger.

settings.title: Content policy
settings.body: Customers may upload only photos they control or have permission to use. DreamShootAI scene packs are for private customer galleries and storefront-approved creative categories.

settings.question: Can I try DreamShootAI for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Uploads, jobs, albums, orders, and credits are scoped to the current site and the current customer account.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the current storefront and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in the ledger.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@dreamshootai.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.question: Can I try DreamShootAI for free?

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Uploads, jobs, albums, orders, and credits are scoped to the current site and the current customer account.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: FAQ
settings.subtitle: Answer pricing, privacy, uploads, and plan questions before customers spend credits.
settings.journeyDescriptions: Add clean source photos.|Pick a scene or style.|AI builds your set.|Download from the private gallery.

settings.question: Can I try DreamShootAI for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Uploads, jobs, albums, orders, and credits are scoped to the current site and the current customer account.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.question: Can I try DreamShootAI for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Uploads, jobs, albums, orders, and credits are scoped to the current site and the current customer account.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.
